content: Fà ukwà tii u mɔ̈ɔ̈
Bɛ, bɛ làkäl bàŋàkwà ntɔn ibii anà man'be abɛ,
amà làkyerà bɛ umpal làyilabà bɛ nzam a mɛɛn mà, Mwan a mfum awà afyekyekà uboboo a du anà mɛɛn, dweelà làfàsal apanà uboo a baar a un'tswe ngwal.

Bi banswà sye, bi bàkäl un'lwaaŋ mwɛy anà baar abà, fà itaan, mulabà ngyal a ndür abi, bi bàkyerà ukwen aya, bàläbà an'kyän aya. Unsà imbuur, bi bàkälà baan a nkyɛl asànaa baar bumwɛy.
Wɛɛ, ntɔn Nzam wàŋàyɔl a ngyɛb, anà nde kikwen unsà ukwen a kölàköl,
umpal kàkäl bi bàŋàkwà ntɔn ibii abi, nde kipɛ mɔ̈ɔ̈ anà Klistɔ Yɛsu - yà unsà kab a ngway waa bɛ làwü mɔ̈ɔ̈,
anà nde, nde kiwiiy anà kibwääy u du, amu Yɛsu Klistɔ.
Kyakin, u mbwo a ubwaŋ ande ntɔn bi amu Klistɔ Yɛsu, nde kàkwen muswaŋ u mbul a in'tye ayà isàyà, un'naaŋ a kölàköl wà kab a ngway ande.
Abun, yà unsà kab a ngway waa bɛ làwü mɔ̈ɔ̈, u mbwo a làkwikilà. Bɛ làkyer anki akà undiir, wɛɛ la là kab a Nzam.
Ya kàyan'fà anki unsà isal, ntɔn mbuur uswɛŋ ngaal.
Ntɔn nde kikyer, nde kiyilà amu Klistɔ Yɛsu, ntɔn isal aŋàbwaŋ kàlɔ̈ɔ̈n Nzam kusà, ntɔn bi ikölà bya.
Un'sɛŋ mwɛy amu Klistɔ Yɛsu

Kyakin, làyɔbà naa utaaŋ itaan bɛ làkäl anà idiim a baar mpa abà Ayudà u ndür abɛ, bɛ baar bàlabeelà baar mpa abà aŋàkyɛy, akà baar bàfàkyey uyɔl naa ba bàŋàkyɛy, ntɔn ba bye anà idiim a nkyɛɛy bàkyer baar u ndür aba.
Làyɔbà naa utaaŋ alanà, bɛ làkäl anki anà Klistɔ uboo a bɛ, bɛ làkwe anki mukal baan a Isàlɛl, bɛ làkäl angyey u nkwà yanswà yà ntɔn ilää, ukɔɔn làkyän anà ukɔɔn Nzam u mɛɛn.
Wɛɛ apanà, u mbwo a un'tüüb abɛ anà Klistɔ Yɛsu, bɛ baar làkälà ukwɛl, bɛ làkyàbulà tsütsü u mbwo a an'kil a Klistɔ.
Abun, nde wà duu abi: nde kàbuul Ayudà anà baar mpa abà Ayudà un'sɛŋ mwɛy. U mbwo a ndür ande, nde kàbwaab ibä a nkaabà akyà un'yiiŋ.
Nde kàdwä un'kɔɔn anà nswɛɛŋ awa anà nsyääl awa. Abà, nde kàkwen naa fà Un'yudà anà mbuur mpa awà Un'yudà, nde ukyer mbuur mwɛy wàkün, mubiil duu,
anà mutüüb ba bàbɔ̈ɔ̈l ndür mwɛy, anà kàfuur un'tüüb aba anà Nzam. U mbwo a kulunsi, nde kàdwä iyiiŋ.
Nde kàyi mukyään duu akà bɛ baar làkäl ukwɛl, anà duu akà baar bàkäl tsütsü.
Kyakin, u mbwo a nde, amwɛy anà bamwɛy, unsà Dweelà mwɛy mpɛl, bi ibye anà mbwo mukɔlà apà Taa.
Abun, bɛ làfàkal anki angyey, itàkal alyaaŋ a mbwo, wɛɛ bɛ làbà aŋàbul mbwo mwɛy anà aŋin'kyɛɛl, baar a bɔr a Nzam.
Bɛ, bɛ bàkyàlabiil unsà ntööŋ, un'bään a ya antööm anà aŋangɔɔm, anà Klistɔ Yɛsu nde ŋakwo wà nkɔŋ a twɛrà.
Yà u mbwo ande, waa ndwà yanswà yàmutsim anà yàmuyɛl ntɔn mubulà idwà in'kyɛɛl unsà Mwol.
Amu nde, bɛ sye làbà mbwo mwɛy bàŋàbilà uboo a ntööŋ ntɔn mubulà ndwà a Nzam u mbwo a Dweelà.
